alt: 孩子的腳踏車已經爆胎，只好推著走，天空又突然下起大雨，讓回家的路更加狼狽。
scene_prompt: 雪上加霜 means another setback makes an already difficult situation worse. Modern child with a correctly worn bicycle helmet stands safely on the SIDEWALK beside a bicycle with a visibly COMPLETELY FLAT front tire. Unable to ride, the child is already pushing the bike home; now sudden rain starts, soaking the child's sleeves and making small puddles. Disappointed expression and the combination of obvious flat tire PLUS newly falling rain convey two accumulating problems. A dry sheltered bus-stop canopy is nearby so the child is safe. No traffic danger, no crash, no injury, no thunder or dramatic flood. Warm sympathetic storybook mood, no literal snow is needed.
